items.title: Rust fs core: blocking helper, path canonicalisation, read/write/stat, directory listing
items.rationale: Used by code lut keeps regardless of the explorer: fs::blocking/to_canon by workspace.rs:260-278, shell/session.rs:8, control.rs:119, agent.rs:592, secrets.rs:132, lib.rs:53; fs_stat/fs_canonicalize by terminal link opening (terminalLinks.ts:179,187; TER-006 adjacent); fs_read_dir by path completion (terminal/block/lib/pathComplete.ts:53); list_subdirs by CwdBreadcrumb.tsx:183; fs_read_file/fs_write_file/fs_stat by theme files (theme/themeFiles.ts:30-37, useThemeFileEditing.ts:39). No Terax identity is stored here.
couplings: backend-core (workspace.rs, shell, control.rs, agent.rs use fs::blocking / fs::to_canon)
items.risks: fs_read_file / fs_write_file are also the editor's IO path; removing the editor must not remove them.

items.title: Sensitive-path read policy (deny runtime cache dir and secret files)
items.rationale: read_policy.rs:15 denies reads under <cache>/terax, which is where control.rs:757-758 writes the control-server runtime file (token). When the control server moves to lut's own runtime dir (F0:10, identity:1) the policy must deny lut's dir too (keep denying Terax's). It also include_str!s src/modules/ai/lib/pathPolicy.json (read_policy.rs:20-22), so the AI removal must move that file first (14.1).
items.risks: If the control runtime dir is renamed without updating this policy, the asset protocol / any remaining read command could expose lut's control token.

items.title: asset:// URI scheme with per-webview grants
items.rationale: Generic, policy-checked file serving (lib.rs:219 register_asynchronous_uri_scheme_protocol("asset"), asset_grant/asset_revoke at lib.rs:306-307, used via src/lib/useAssetGrant.ts). Today only editor media preview and markdown use it, but PRO-012 (profile icon from an image file) needs exactly this to show user images safely.
items.risks: None identified.

items.title: fs create/rename/move/delete commands
items.rationale: Used outside the explorer: theme files create_dir/delete (theme/themeFiles.ts:34,49). Profiles/projects export-import (8.x) can reuse it. Explorer and AI are the other consumers.
items.risks: None.

items.title: Shared file watcher (notify / FSEvents) and fs:changed events
items.rationale: Infrastructure, not UI: git/watch.rs registers repositories with it (used by the header branch indicator via app/components/useGitBranch.ts:1) and it feeds the file index (watch.rs:70). Projects/presets file watching can reuse it. macOS queue label app.crynta.terax.fsevents (watch/macos.rs:202) is internal: rename on touch.
items.risks: If every consumer is removed it becomes dead weight; re-evaluate after ide-tools-D01.

items.title: AI-only fs commands (ai_read_file/ai_read_dir/ai_grep/ai_glob, TERAX.md project memory)
items.rationale: Only consumer is the BYOK AI module (ai/lib/native.ts:49-98). lut removes BYOK AI (F2:4, 9.9:1, 9.9:5). project_memory reads TERAX.md, an AI concept. The read_policy tests that live in ai.rs:440-452 must move to read_policy.rs.
items.risks: Deleting ai.rs drops the only tests of readable(); move them first.

items.title: Explorer-only fs commands: recursive copy, OS clipboard file paths
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): explorer stays as a secondary tool. (Analyst: Only consumers are explorer paste/drop (explorer/lib/clipboardPaste.ts, useExplorerFileDrop.ts, batchMove.ts). Fate follows the explorer decision (UX-009, F2:6, F6:3).)
items.risks: copy.rs:132 temp prefix .terax-copy- is internal (rename on touch).

items.title: File index, fuzzy file search and ripgrep-style content search
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): palette file/content search and the index stay. (Analyst: Consumers: command palette file/content search (command-palette/hooks/useFileSearch.ts:47-106, useContentSearch.ts:31) and AI (useWorkspaceFiles.ts:30). UX-008 wants a palette oriented to terminal/project actions, not files; whether file search survives is undecided (ide-tools-D01). Brings cargo deps ignore, grep-regex, grep-searcher, globset, nucleo-matcher.)
items.risks: If removed, check fs/tree.rs still compiles: tree.rs uses ignore (Cargo dep stays).

items.title: Git CLI backend: status/diff/stage/commit/fetch/push/log/branches + change watcher
items.rationale: UI-free backend (shells out to git, no git2) behind the optional Git panel (UX-009 P1, F6:3) and the header branch indicator (useGitBranch.ts:1). F1:6 says hide UI but do not delete backend. User-visible error text 'Terax needs git' (errors.rs:53) is visual rebranding; event name terax:git-changed (watch.rs:26) is internal. Small touch-ups happen inside ide-tools-D04 (mod.rs, git_watch move, refs.rs checkpoint prefix).
items.risks: tests/git_operations.rs:717-727 exercises worktree::list/prune/remove, which ide-tools-D04 deletes.

items.title: Unwired agent-task backend: task worktrees, checkpoints, review hunks, branch create/rename
items.rationale: ~14k lines registered at lib.rs:353-374 with zero frontend callers (no use of git.checkpoint*/worktree*/applyHunks/branchCreate/upstreamInfo outside src/modules/git/api.ts). Not in the proposal (no worktree/checkpoint requirement). It also carries dormant Terax identity: refs/terax/* in user repos (refs.rs:6, checkpoint.rs:639), ~/.terax/worktrees (commands_review.rs:121, project_config.rs:35,355), ~/.terax state (task_state.rs:73), .terax/project.toml (project_config.rs:121), TERAX_TASK/TERAX_PORT env (task_worktree.rs:96-102), branch prefix terax/ (project_config.rs:38). Removing it resolves those F0:10 concerns instead of renaming. git_watch/git_unwatch (commands_review.rs) must move to commands.rs first. Open question: does the user want agent worktrees as a lut feature?
items.risks: Large mechanical deletion; the test files cross-import review_tests/testutil, so they must go together.

items.title: Frontend git invoke wrappers, types and git-changed subscription
items.rationale: Keep the wrappers used by source control, git history, explorer status and the header branch (useGitBranch.ts:1); drop the dead review/worktree/checkpoint/branch wrappers and types (api.ts:~230-325) together with the backend removal.
items.risks: None.

items.title: Dead frontend review models (hunk selection, diff scopes incl. checkpoint scopes)
items.rationale: Only re-exported by src/modules/git/index.ts:4-5; no consumer outside src/modules/git. Belongs to the unwired review/checkpoint feature (ide-tools/git-agent-tasks).
items.risks: None.

items.title: Source Control panel view
items.rationale: Terax visual component (1490 lines) mounted from the sidebar (App.tsx:74, SidebarRail.tsx:25). lut keeps Git only as an optional secondary panel (UX-009, F6:3, 10.2:6) whose look the user designs; Terax's UI is not a baseline.
items.risks: Panel embeds behaviour (keyboard handling, dialogs); extract into source-control-logic before deleting.

items.title: Source control state hooks, repository targeting, watch wiring
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): Git panel stays as an on-demand, lazy-loaded secondary tool (F2:6, UX-009). (Analyst: Non-visual logic of the Git panel (UX-009 P1, F6:3); kept only if the Git panel survives ide-tools-D01. Must lose the AI commit-message generation regardless (useSourceControlPanel.ts:8 useChatStore, :13 ai/config, :874 dynamic import of ai/lib/agent) because BYOK AI goes (F2:4).)
items.risks: useSourceControlPanel.ts (1038 lines) mixes UI state and IPC; split carefully.

items.title: Git history / graph view
items.rationale: Visual tab content (git-history tab kind in useTabs, WorkspaceSurface.tsx:4). Proposal keeps Git only as an optional secondary tool (F6:3, UX-009); look is user-designed. lazygit in a pane already covers history (TER-007).
items.risks: Removing the tab kind touches useTabs (tabs area).

items.title: Commit graph layout and remote web URL helpers
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): Git history stays as an on-demand, lazy-loaded secondary tool (F2:6, UX-009). (Analyst: Pure logic with tests (graph.ts lane layout, remoteWebUrl.ts). Kept only if a history view survives ide-tools-D01.)
items.risks: None.

items.title: File explorer views (tree, rows, inline rename, search box)
items.rationale: Visual Terax sidebar content; 10.2:6 says the sidebar becomes project navigation without a permanent explorer; explorer survives at most as an optional secondary panel (UX-009, F6:3) with the user's design.
items.risks: FileExplorer.tsx (1088 lines) contains drag-to-terminal path insertion and keyboard behaviour that is logic, not look.

items.title: Explorer tree model, fs ops, DnD, clipboard paste, git status decoration, watch registry
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): explorer stays as an on-demand, lazy-loaded secondary tool (F2:6, UX-009). (Analyst: Behaviour of the optional explorer (UX-009, F2:6). lib/watch.ts is also used by the editor (useEditorFileSync.ts:6) and markdown (useMarkdownDocument.ts:6), so it moves to a neutral module if the explorer goes but editor/markdown stay. useGitStatus.ts:1 imports ai/lib/native (coupling to AI removal).)
items.risks: None beyond the shared watch helper.

items.title: File/folder icon theme (Catppuccin icon mapping) and FileIcon component
items.rationale: Purely visual (3.3k lines of icon mapping + @iconify-json/catppuccin). Used by TabBar.tsx:24, CommandPalette.tsx:12, ai FilePicker.tsx:4, git-history, source-control. lut tabs show profile icons (PRO-012), not file icons; any file iconography is the user's design.
items.risks: Removing it before the tab bar is redesigned breaks TabBar imports.

items.title: Editor AI features: inline AI autocomplete and AI diff review panes
items.rationale: BYOK AI features (autocomplete/provider.ts:7-9 imports ai/config, ai/lib/agent, ai/lib/keyring; EditorPane.tsx:1-2 reads provider keys). lut drops BYOK AI (F2:4, 9.9:1). AiDiffStack is mounted by WorkspaceSurface.tsx:3 for the ai-diff tab kind.
items.risks: inlineExtension.ts is detected as binary (NUL byte) by the partition tool; it is TS source.

items.title: Editor visual themes (CodeMirror themes, chrome theme)
items.rationale: Purely visual; Terax look is not a baseline. Pulls the @uiw/codemirror-theme-* packages. Any editor theming follows the user's design and lut theme tokens (F3:5 per-pane themes are for terminals).
items.risks: compositingBudget.test.ts hard-codes the chromeTheme.ts path.

items.title: Git diff panes and diff cache
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): diff stays as an on-demand, lazy-loaded secondary tool (F2:6, UX-009). (Analyst: Diff is explicitly an optional secondary tool (UX-009, F6:3, 6.2:8); whether lut keeps an in-app diff (vs. lazygit/delta in a pane) is decided in ide-tools-D01. Uses @codemirror/merge.)
items.risks: None.

items.title: CodeMirror editor: panes, document model, languages, formatting, vim, media preview
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): editor stays as an on-demand, lazy-loaded secondary tool (F2:6, F6:3, UX-009). (Analyst: Proposal: not an IDE (goal 2/§2 line 93), editing is a secondary on-demand utility (goal 7, line 53; 5.10:12 'optional and lazy, do not remove without analysis'; F2:6 decide what to keep; F6:3 editor in optional secondary window/panel). Also used to edit theme files (useThemeFileEditing.ts) and by TabBar (languageDefinitions/languageResolver at TabBar.tsx:22-23), settings EditorSection.tsx:13-14 and header SearchInline.tsx:4. Visual parts (EditorPane chrome, NewEditorDialog) will be redone with the user's design if kept.)
items.risks: CodeMirror core packages (@codemirror/state/view/language/commands/autocomplete, @lezer/highlight) must stay even if the editor goes: the terminal block input uses them (terminal/block/lib/shellEditor.ts, ShellInput.tsx).

items.title: Open-file navigator registry used by terminal link activation
items.rationale: Not LSP-specific: App.tsx:1395 registers openFile and terminal/lib/terminalLinks.ts:17,175 uses it to open clicked file paths. Move to a neutral module (e.g. app/ or workspace) so terminal link opening survives an LSP removal and can target whatever lut opens files with (editor, external editor).
items.risks: None.

items.title: Language Server support (frontend client/session manager + Rust process host) and editor diagnostics
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): LSP stays with the editor; loaded on demand. (Analyst: The proposal never mentions LSP; it only exists to serve the editor, which is secondary (goal 7, 5.10:12). Recommendation: remove (F2:6, F6:gate keeps tools lightweight) unless the user wants a code-intelligent editor; decided in ide-tools-D01. Spawns language servers (lsp/mod.rs:62-90) and depends on codemirror-languageserver.)
couplings: lib.rs:271,322-327,451 state + commands + kill on exit
items.risks: LspStatusPill.tsx:180 shows 'Terax found no ...' (visual rebranding if kept).

items.title: Markdown preview tab view
items.rationale: Visual tab content (WorkspaceSurface.tsx:5). Proposal does not list markdown preview among kept tools; if kept it is a secondary tool with the user's design. MarkdownLink is also used by the AI chat (AiChat.tsx:17) which goes away. Uses streamdown via components/ai-elements/markdown-code and checkReadable from ai/lib/security (MarkdownPreviewPane.tsx:2).
items.risks: streamdown is shared with the AI chat; removing it is the AI area's call.

items.title: Markdown document loading, relative asset paths, live reload
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): markdown preview stays as an on-demand secondary tool. (Analyst: Logic behind the markdown preview; kept only if markdown preview survives ide-tools-D01.)
items.risks: None.

items.title: In-app web preview tab (iframe + address bar)
items.rationale: Visual tab content (WorkspaceSurface.tsx:6, tab.newPreview shortcut App.tsx:916). Not mentioned by the proposal; recommendation is to drop it (not terminal-first, §2 goal 2) unless the user wants it; decided in ide-tools-D01.
items.risks: Persisted Spaces may contain preview tabs; deserialization must tolerate them after removal.

items.title: Preview URL policy and dev-server frame-ancestors test
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): web preview stays as an on-demand secondary tool. (Analyst: previewUrl.ts blocks app-internal hosts (incl. terax-pty.localhost, previewUrl.ts:5) and is also imported by ai/tools/terminal.ts:1. devFramePolicy.test.ts actually tests vite.config.ts frame-ancestors (app hardening), so it should move to app tests if preview goes.)
items.risks: If the PTY URI scheme is renamed, RESERVED_HOSTS must follow.

notes: Cross-area: (1) fs core/assets/mutate/watch are used by terminal (links, path completion), statusbar, theme, backend-core, agents/control; never remove them with the explorer. (2) read_policy.rs denies <cache>/terax (control runtime dir, control.rs:757) and include_str!s src/modules/ai/lib/pathPolicy.json: control-server rename and AI removal must update it. (3) git agent-task backend (worktrees/checkpoints/review, ~14k lines) is registered but has no frontend caller; it holds dormant Terax identity (refs/terax/*, ~/.terax/worktrees, .terax/project.toml, TERAX_* env). (4) CodeMirror core packages are used by the terminal block input, so only editor-specific packages (@uiw/*, @replit/codemirror-vim, codemirror-languageserver, lang-*, @codemirror/merge/lint/search/legacy-modes?) can go with the editor; legacy-modes/shell is used by the terminal. (5) LSP navigator is actually the terminal link 'open file' hook. (6) The Rust crate is named terax_lib (tests/*.rs import it) - build-identity area.
